eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 2:31 AM on AUG 17, 2026 Effective until 10:31 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A SAFE Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Glendale Police Department is looking for Abraham Cabrera JR. Hispanic male, 21 years old, 5 feet 6 inches, 130 pounds, brown eyes, brown hair and last seen were a gray ninja turtle sweatshirt with black pants. Abraham was last seen on 08/16/2026 at 2130 hours on foot near 75th Avenue and Pasadena Avenue. Abraham suffers from a medical condition with may cause him to become easily confused and lost. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
